metadata.occupancy_warning: Coverage reflects the selected 275-role inventory. It is not a population probability distribution.
metadata.native_space_warning: Each native panel uses its model's own canonical PC1-PC3 coordinates.
metadata.aligned_space_warning: Display alignment uses the shared 275-role inventory. Axes are aligned display coordinates, not universally shared native PC meanings.
metadata.density_method: scipy gaussian_kde, full covariance, Scott factor
